comment: Floor metres, same frame as wifi detection/host/floorplan.json: origin front-left, x to the right as seen from the door, y away from the door. Headings are degrees counter-clockwise from +x, seen from above. "area" is where the robots may drive (what the camera sees); people can be found in the whole WiFi area. Sensing boards are fixed by default: if a robot carries its board, rename that robot's "board_if_carried" to "sensing_mac". Walls come from the WiFi floor plan's "walls" (or a "walls" list here). "tracking": "colour" uses the robots' SSL patterns; "aruco" uses printed markers.
